# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b21 - Canonical environment_manager domain repair

Beta21 corrects the Home Assistant integration domain spelling introduced by beta20.

## Canonical domain

The installed package is now only:

- `custom_components/environment_manager`
- manifest/runtime domain `environment_manager`

The beta20 typo `enviroment_manager` is no longer the canonical package.

## Upgrade migration

The migration flow accepts both previous domains:

- `air_quality_advisor` from beta19 and earlier
- `enviroment_manager` from beta20

It moves Home Environment Manager entity/device registry ownership to `environment_manager` while preserving entity IDs, unique IDs, device IDs, config subentries, disabled states, user customizations and controller settings. It also carries storage migration history forward so direct beta19 -> beta21 and chained beta19 -> beta20 -> beta21 upgrades remain supported.

Because HACS can only install one integration folder from this repository, an old-domain entry may be unavailable immediately after the folder replacement. Add Home Environment Manager once if needed; the flow detects the existing legacy entry and presents migration rather than creating a second independent home.

## Compatibility aliases

During the beta migration window, service/card compatibility remains for the historical domains and beta20 typo. The authoritative services and frontend path are under `environment_manager`.

## Climate/controller behavior

This release intentionally keeps beta20's controller behavior unchanged:

- Room Environment owns Comfort, Home, Sleep and explicit Eco heating/cooling targets.
- Away is selected only when nobody-home evidence is verified and uses the room temperature bounds.
- Explicit room sensors remain authoritative controller feedback.
- Room-wide limits continue to constrain every compatible managed controller.
- Selecting Automatic or PID on a native climate/fan/humidifier controller authorizes that exact controller to start/stop and switch supported modes when demand and policy require it.
- Existing minimum ON/OFF time, maximum runtime, availability, open-window, interlock, acknowledgement and ownership safeguards remain.

## Validation

Publication is gated on Python 3.13 and 3.14 regression suites, deterministic generated catalogs, frontend checks, Hassfest, HACS and installed Home Assistant 2026.10 registry migration verification for both previous domains.

This is an opt-in prerelease. Stable Latest remains v0.5.1.
